sources.title: zai-org/GLM-5.2 | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: GLM-5.2 is the newest model in the GLM-5 series — a ~743B-parameter MoE (39B active) from Z-AI. The headline change over GLM-5 / 5.1 is that Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) is extended from 3 to 5 draft tokens, lifting end-to-end throughput on reasoning, coding, and agentic workloads.

sources.snippet: Overview GLM-5.2-MXFP8-NVFP4-NF3-Hybrid is a 753-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts language model maintained by madeby561 that fits on 4× 96GB sm120 GPUs through a hybrid quantization strategy: the 256 experts per layer use mixed precision (64 slots per layer in NVFP4 4-bit format, the remainder in NF3 3-bit format), while non-expert layers (attention, dense, shared) are stored in BF16 and ...

sources.title: GitHub - tonyd2wild/GLM-5.2-NF3-Hybrid-4x-DGX-Spark-800kctx
sources.snippet: GLM-5.2 NF3-Hybrid on 4× DGX Spark — 67.4 tok/s aggregate / 800K context Unpruned GLM-5.2 (753B/40B MoE, all 256 experts) in a 3-format NVFP4/NF3/MXFP8 hybrid quant (327GB), ported from 4× RTX PRO 6000 to 4× DGX Spark (GB10, sm_121a, aarch64) and served in two launch lanes: a fast 200K lane (67.4 tok/s aggregate) and an 800K-context lane.
